validation.summary: All three lines match catalog items WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX at the listed unit prices. Stock is insufficient for WidgetA and WidgetB, and sufficient for GadgetX.

vp.rationale: Reject INV-1007 (MegaWidgets Corp, USD). Fixed outcome is reject: three error-level findings. WidgetA: 20 requested at catalog $250.00 ($5,000.00) but stock is 15. WidgetB: 15 requested at catalog $500.00 ($7,500.00) but stock is 10. GadgetX: 3 × $750.00 = $2,250.00 matches catalog; stock 5 is sufficient. Stated total $15,525.00 understates the computed total $15,635.00 by $110.00 (subtotal $14,750.00; stated tax $885.00). No prior runs for this number. Unit prices are not above catalog. Errors require rejection.
checklist_responses: Errors: WidgetA stock 15 vs 20 requested; WidgetB stock 10 vs 15 requested; total understated by $110.00 ($15,525.00 stated vs $15,635.00 computed). Any error requires reject.
Currency is USD, so non-USD review does not apply.
Catalog prices match: WidgetA $250.00, WidgetB $500.00, GadgetX $750.00. None above catalog.
No evidence this is a revised invoice.
Invoice history for INV-1007 has no prior runs, so no invoice-number conflict.
Computed total $15,635.00 exceeds $10,000.00, but error findings already fix the outcome at reject. No separate risk signal (payment redirect or other vendor) is corroborated.
GadgetX stock (5) covers the quantity of 3; this does not offset the WidgetA and WidgetB shortfalls.

critic.summary: The reject decision matches the fixed policy outcome and every factual claim is corroborated by the case file, catalog stock, and invoice history.
